rows.g: āthabbaṇikā āthabbaṇaṁ payojenti, nagare vā ruddhe1 saṅgāme vā paccupaṭṭhite parasenapaccatthikesu paccāmittesu ītiṁ uppādenti, upaddavaṁ uppādenti, rogaṁ uppādenti, pajjarakaṁ karonti, sūlaṁ karonti, visūcikaṁ karonti, pakkhandikaṁ karonti.

rows.l: Āthabbaṇaṁ supinaṁ lakkhaṇaṁ, no vidahe athopi nakkhattan
rows.g: āthabbaṇañca supinañca lakkhaṇañca nakkhattañca no vidaheyya na careyya na samācareyya na samādāya vatteyya.
